_why: XbSymbolDatabase does not cover XMV, the video library, so these
addresses had no names and could not be replaced by name.
scripts/section_calls.py finds six calls crossing into the XMV section
(0x0012FD60..0x001571F4), all from the movie code at
0x000E8A00..0x000E8CF0, and they are named from how it calls them. This
older library has no Start (the first Update starts playback) and fetches
a DirectSound stream per audio track through XMVPlaybackGetAudioStream.

symbols.name: XMVPlaybackGetStreamInfo
symbols._note: 0x0013041B. From 0x000E8BCB: (handle, &info); the caller checks width 640 and height 480.

symbols.name: XMVPlaybackCreateAudioStream
symbols._note: 0x00130488. From 0x000E8C32 in a loop over the audio stream count: (handle, index, 0, 0, 0).

symbols.name: XMVPlaybackUpdate
symbols._note: 0x00130624. From 0x000E8CA3 and 0x000E8D25: (handle, surface, &status, 0); status 1 is a new picture, 2 and 3 the end.
